notes: The official homepage and 14th Street location page identify the only current Chicken + Whiskey location as 1738 14th St NW and link both its retail and catering Toast storefronts.

The location page's stray Howard County employee-discount sentence is ignored as a template artifact; the address, phone number, and location-linked menus consistently identify the Washington, DC restaurant.

sources.excerpt: Official homepage identifies the 14th Street DC location and links its location page, menu PDFs, and restaurant ordering flow.
Official location page gives 1738 14th St NW, Washington, DC 20009 and links the current Food, Bebidas, retail Toast, and catering Toast surfaces.

Restaurant-linked one-page food PDF lists pollo a la brasa, sauces, sides, extras, sandwiches, arepas, soup/salad/pasta, kids meals, and desserts with ingredient descriptions and vegetarian/nut/gluten-friendly/halal icons; it contains no comprehensive allergen matrix or cross-contact statement.
Restaurant-linked Bebidas PDF lists bottled water, Topo Chico, canned/bottled iced tea, Inca Kola, Mexican Coca-Cola, Jarritos, Guarana, and Red Bull before its alcohol section.

Official-domain, linked Drive-document, PDF, sitemap, FAQ, image, nutrition, ingredient, and allergen searches surfaced the current menu PDFs and an obsolete 2021 menu, but no official allergen or nutrition guide.

Officially linked retail storefront for Chicken + Whiskey 14th Street at 1738 14th Street. It exposes the current retail food and nonalcoholic catalog with item descriptions, including seasonal and out-of-stock presentations, but no allergen matrix or cross-contact disclosure.

Officially linked catering storefront at the same address. It adds catering presentations plus Paquete Total Catering, Arroz con Leche, and Churros; no allergen matrix or cross-contact disclosure appears.

Targeted exact-business and domain searches found the official location/menu pages, current Toast storefronts, and an obsolete 2021 restaurant PDF, but no current official allergen matrix, ingredient guide, nutrition guide, or cross-contact statement.

findings.summary: The 46-row baseline represents only part of the retail Toast food catalog and omits current official PDF sauces, kids meals, nonalcoholic beverages, catering-only products, and two current retail products.
The generic Pollo A La Brasa baseline row is a menu section/description rather than a separately orderable product; its portion products remain current.

The baseline assigns wheat to plain rotisserie chicken, rice, beans, slaw, plantain chips, potato wedges, and cilantro mojo chicken despite no direct source support, and it omits explicit soy/sesame or dairy/egg positives on several described products. The proposal preserves only source-anchored ingredient positives and otherwise marks official allergen data unavailable.
All four required searches found current menus and ingredient descriptions but no comprehensive official allergen matrix or cross-contact guide.

proposedChanges: Replace the partial 46-row boundary with the 66-product consolidated union of the current restaurant-issued food and beverage PDFs plus the location-linked retail and catering Toast surfaces, excluding alcohol and service/cutlery modifiers.
Remove the generic Pollo A La Brasa section-heading artifact, normalize the carne empanada name, and retain repeated retail/catering/menu-PDF presentations as source references on one product.

Remove unsupported baseline allergen smear from plain chicken, rice, beans, slaw, plantains, potato wedges, and similar descriptions; preserve only direct ingredient positives from the restaurant-issued menu or restaurant-linked catering description.
Mark products without direct official allergen evidence unavailable because all four required searches found no comprehensive matrix or cross-contact guide.
